232:     /** Falls back to a real BusyBox applet for anything the built-ins lack. */
233:     private fun runExternal(cmd: String, args: List<String>, dir: File, stdin: String): Result {
234:         val bb = busybox
235:         if (bb != null && bb.isAvailable() && bb.knowsApplet(cmd)) {
236:             val r = bb.run(listOf(cmd) + args, dir, stdin, BUSYBOX_TIMEOUT_MS)
237:             return Result(r.exitCode, r.stdout + (if (r.stderr.isNotBlank()) r.stderr else ""))
238:         }
239:         val hint = if (bb != null && bb.isAvailable()) {
240:             " (встроенные: ${COMMANDS.joinToString(", ")}; плюс любой applet busybox)"
241:         } else {
242:             " (доступно: ${COMMANDS.joinToString(", ")})"
243:         }
244:         return Result(127, "bash: $cmd: команда не найдена$hint\n")
245:     }

247:     private fun flagsFree(args: List<String>): List<String> = args.filter { !it.startsWith("-") }

249:     private fun ls(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
250:         val all = args.any { it == "-a" || it == "-la" || it == "-al" }
251:         val long = args.any { it == "-l" || it == "-la" || it == "-al" || it == "-lh" }
252:         val targets = flagsFree(args).ifEmpty { listOf(".") }
253:         val out = StringBuilder()
254:         var exit = 0
255:         for (t in targets) {
256:             val f = sandboxPath(t, dir)
257:             if (f == null || !f.exists()) { exit = 1; out.append("ls: $t: нет такого файла\n"); continue }
258:             val entries = when {
259:                 f.isDirectory -> f.listFiles()?.sortedBy { it.name.lowercase() } ?: emptyList()
260:                 else -> listOf(f)
261:             }.filter { all || !it.name.startsWith(".") }
262:             if (targets.size > 1) out.append("${t}:\n")
263:             for (e in entries) {
264:                 if (long) {
265:                     out.append("%s %8d  %s\n".format(if (e.isDirectory()) "d" else "-", e.length(), e.name))
266:                 } else {
267:                     out.append(if (e.isDirectory()) e.name + "/" else e.name)
268:                     out.append("\n")
269:                 }
270:             }
271:             if (targets.size > 1) out.append("\n")
272:         }
273:         return Result(exit, out.toString())
274:     }

276:     private fun cat(args: List<String>, dir: File, stdin: String): Result {
277:         if (args.isEmpty() || args.first() == "-") return Result(0, stdin)
278:         val out = StringBuilder()
279:         var exit = 0
280:         for (a in args) {
281:             val f = sandboxPath(a, dir)
282:             if (f == null || !f.isFile) { exit = 1; out.append("cat: $a: нет такого файла\n"); continue }
283:             if (f.length() > MAX_FILE) { exit = 1; out.append("cat: $a: файл слишком большой\n"); continue }
284:             out.append(f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8))
285:         }
286:         return Result(exit, out.toString())
287:     }

289:     private fun mkdir(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
290:         val recursive = args.any { it == "-p" }
291:         var exit = 0
292:         val out = StringBuilder()
293:         for (a in flagsFree(args)) {
294:             val f = sandboxPath(a, dir)
295:             if (f == null) { exit = 1; continue }
296:             if (f.exists()) {

298:                 continue
299:             }
300:             if (recursive) f.mkdirs() else f.mkdir()
301:             if (!f.isDirectory) { exit = 1; out.append("mkdir: $a: не удалось создать\n") }
302:         }
303:         return Result(exit, out.toString())
304:     }

306:     private fun rm(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
307:         val recursive = args.any { it == "-r" || it == "-rf" || it == "-fr" || it == "-R" }
308:         var exit = 0
309:         val out = StringBuilder()
310:         for (a in flagsFree(args)) {

312:             if (f == null || !f.exists()) { exit = 1; out.append("rm: $a: нет такого файла\n"); continue }
313:             if (f.isDirectory && !recursive) { exit = 1; out.append("rm: $a: это каталог (нужен -r)\n"); continue }
314:             if (!f.deleteRecursively()) { exit = 1; out.append("rm: $a: не удалось удалить\n") }
315:         }
316:         return Result(exit, out.toString())
317:     }

319:     private fun mv(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
320:         val files = flagsFree(args)
321:         if (files.size < 2) return Result(1, "mv: использование: mv <откуда> <куда>\n")
322:         val from = sandboxPath(files[0], dir) ?: return Result(1, "mv: путь вне песочницы\n")
323:         val to = sandboxPath(files[1], dir) ?: return Result(1, "mv: путь вне песочницы\n")
324:         if (!from.exists()) return Result(1, "mv: ${files[0]}: нет такого файла\n")
325:         val target = if (to.isDirectory) File(to, from.name) else to
326:         target.parentFile?.mkdirs()
327:         return if (from.renameTo(target)) Result(0, "") else Result(1, "mv: не удалось переместить\n")
328:     }

330:     private fun cp(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
331:         val files = flagsFree(args)
332:         if (files.size < 2) return Result(1, "cp: использование: cp <откуда> <куда>\n")
333:         val from = sandboxPath(files[0], dir) ?: return Result(1, "cp: путь вне песочницы\n")
334:         val to = sandboxPath(files[1], dir) ?: return Result(1, "cp: путь вне песочницы\n")
335:         if (!from.exists()) return Result(1, "cp: ${files[0]}: нет такого файла\n")
336:         val target = if (to.isDirectory) File(to, from.name) else to
337:         return try {
338:             if (from.isDirectory) from.copyRecursively(target, overwrite = true)
339:             else { target.parentFile?.mkdirs(); from.copyTo(target, overwrite = true) }
340:             Result(0, "")
341:         } catch (t: Throwable) { Result(1, "cp: ${t.message}\n") }
342:     }

344:     private fun headTail(args: List<String>, dir: File, fromStart: Boolean): Result {
345:         // head [-n N] [-N] file — `head -n 5 f`, `head -5 f`, `head f` all work.
346:         var n = 10
347:         val files = mutableListOf<String>()
348:         var i = 0
349:         while (i < args.size) {
350:             when {
351:                 args[i] == "-n" && i + 1 < args.size && args[i + 1].toIntOrNull() != null ->
352:                     n = args[++i].toInt()
353:                 args[i].startsWith("-") && args[i].removePrefix("-").toIntOrNull() != null ->
354:                     n = args[i].removePrefix("-").toInt()
355:                 !args[i].startsWith("-") -> files += args[i]
356:             }
357:             i++
358:         }
359:         if (files.isEmpty()) return Result(1, "${if (fromStart) "head" else "tail"}: нужен файл\n")
360:         val f = sandboxPath(files[0], dir) ?: return Result(1, "путь вне песочницы\n")
361:         if (!f.isFile) return Result(1, "${files[0]}: нет такого файла\n")
362:         val lines = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8).lines()
363:         val picked = if (fromStart) lines.take(n) else lines.takeLast(n)
364:         return Result(0, picked.joinToString("\n") + "\n")
365:     }

367:     private fun wc(args: List<String>, dir: File, stdin: String): Result {
368:         val files = flagsFree(args)
369:         val text = when {
370:             files.isEmpty() -> stdin
371:             else -> sandboxPath(files.last(), dir)?.takeIf { it.isFile }?.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
372:                 ?: return Result(1, "wc: ${files.last()}: нет такого файла\n")
373:         }
374:         // A trailing newline does not start a new line (like wc -l).
375:         val lines = text.lines().let { if (text.endsWith("\n")) it.dropLast(1) else it }
376:         return Result(0, "%7d %7d %7d\n".format(lines.size, text.split(Regex("\\s+")).count { it.isNotEmpty() }, text.length))
377:     }

379:     private fun find(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
380:         // find [path] [-name pattern] [-type f|d]
381:         var start = dir
382:         var namePattern: String? = null
383:         var type: Char? = null
384:         var i = 0
385:         while (i < args.size) {
386:             when (args[i]) {
387:                 "-name" -> { if (i + 1 < args.size) namePattern = args[++i] }
388:                 "-type" -> { if (i + 1 < args.size) type = args[++i].firstOrNull() }
389:                 else -> if (!args[i].startsWith("-")) start = sandboxPath(args[i], dir) ?: start
390:             }
391:             i++
392:         }
393:         val out = StringBuilder()
394:         start.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
395:             if (out.length > MAX_OUTPUT) return@forEach
396:             if (type == 'f' && !f.isFile) return@forEach
397:             if (type == 'd' && !f.isDirectory) return@forEach
398:             val rel = f.relativeToOrNull(start) ?: return@forEach
399:             val path = if (rel.path == ".") start.name else start.name + "/" + rel.path
400:             if (namePattern == null || globMatch(namePattern, rel.path) || globMatch(namePattern, f.name)) {
401:                 out.append(path).append('\n')
402:             }
403:         }
404:         return Result(0, out.toString())
405:     }

407:     private fun shellGrep(args: List<String>, dir: File, stdin: String): Result {
408:         val ignoreCase = args.any { it == "-i" }
409:         val rest = args.filter { it != "-i" && it != "-n" && !it.startsWith("-") }
410:         if (rest.isEmpty()) return Result(1, "grep: использование: grep [-i] <шаблон> [файл]\n")
411:         val pattern = try {
412:             if (ignoreCase) Regex(rest[0], RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE) else Regex(rest[0])
413:         } catch (t: Throwable) {
414:             return Result(2, "grep: плохой regex: ${t.message}\n")
415:         }
416:         val text = if (rest.size > 1) {
417:             sandboxPath(rest[1], dir)?.takeIf { it.isFile }?.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
418:                 ?: return Result(1, "grep: ${rest[1]}: нет такого файла\n")
419:         } else stdin
420:         val out = StringBuilder()
421:         text.lines().forEachIndexed { idx, line ->
422:             if (pattern.containsMatchIn(line)) out.append("%d:%s\n".format(idx + 1, line))
423:         }
424:         return Result(if (out.isEmpty()) 1 else 0, out.toString())
425:     }

477:     /**
478:      * A minimal `npm` for the sandbox: init creates package.json, install
479:      * downloads pure-JS packages (into the shared store, which require()
480:      * already resolves), run executes package.json scripts through this shell.
481:      */
482:     private fun npm(args: List<String>, dir: File, timeoutMs: Long): Result {
483:         val sub = args.firstOrNull() ?: return Result(1, "npm: нужна подкоманда: init, install, run, test, ls\n")
484:         val rest = args.drop(1)
485:         return try {
486:             when (sub) {
487:                 "init" -> npmInit(rest, dir)
488:                 "install", "i", "add" -> npmInstall(rest, dir)
489:                 "run" -> npmRun(rest, dir, timeoutMs)
490:                 "test" -> npmRun(listOf("test"), dir, timeoutMs)
491:                 "ls", "list" -> npmLs(dir)
492:                 "--version", "-v" -> Result(0, "npm (PocketRun) — init / install / run / test / ls\n")
493:                 else -> Result(1, "npm: неизвестная подкоманда '$sub' (есть: init, install, run, test, ls)\n")
494:             }
495:         } catch (t: Throwable) {
496:             Result(1, "npm: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}\n")
497:         }
498:     }
499: 
500:     private fun npmInit(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
501:         val pkg = File(dir, "package.json")
502:         if (pkg.isFile && args.none { it == "-y" || it == "--yes" || it == "-f" || it == "--force" }) {
503:             return Result(1, "npm: package.json уже существует (npm init -y чтобы перезаписать)\n")
504:         }
505:         val json = org.json.JSONObject()
506:             .put("name", dir.name.replace(Regex("[^a-z0-9-]"), "-").trim('-').ifEmpty { "project" })
507:             .put("version", "1.0.0")
508:             .put("description", "")
509:             .put("main", "index.js")
510:             .put(
511:                 "scripts",
512:                 org.json.JSONObject().put("test", "echo \"Error: no test specified\" && exit 1"),
513:             )
514:         pkg.writeText(json.toString(2) + "\n", Charsets.UTF_8)
515:         return Result(0, "создан package.json (${json.optString("name")})\n")
516:     }
517: 
518:     private fun npmInstall(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
519:         val pkg = File(dir, "package.json")
520:         val manifest = if (pkg.isFile) org.json.JSONObject(pkg.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)) else org.json.JSONObject()
521:         val specs = args.filter { !it.startsWith("-") }
522:         val toInstall: List<Pair<String, String?>> = if (specs.isEmpty()) {
523:             // no arguments: install everything from package.json dependencies
524:             val deps = manifest.optJSONObject("dependencies")
525:                 ?: return Result(1, "npm: нет пакетов для установки и нет dependencies в package.json\n")
526:             deps.keys().asSequence().map { it to deps.optString(it).takeIf { r -> r != "*" } }.toList()
527:         } else {
528:             specs.mapNotNull { raw ->
529:                 NpxRuntime.parseSpec(raw)?.let { it.name to it.version }
530:             }.ifEmpty { return Result(1, "npm: не удалось разобрать имена пакетов\n") }
531:         }
532:         val out = StringBuilder()
533:         for ((name, version) in toInstall) {
534:             val installed = npxRuntime.install(
535:                 NpxRuntime.PackageSpec(name, version),
536:                 log = { line -> out.append(line).append('\n') },
537:             )
538:             val actual = org.json.JSONObject(File(installed, "package.json").readText(Charsets.UTF_8)).optString("version")
539:             val deps = manifest.optJSONObject("dependencies") ?: org.json.JSONObject().also { manifest.put("dependencies", it) }
540:             deps.put(name, actual)
541:             out.append("✓ ").append(name).append('@').append(actual).append('\n')
542:         }
543:         if (pkg.isFile || toInstall.isNotEmpty()) {
544:             manifest.put("dependencies", manifest.optJSONObject("dependencies") ?: org.json.JSONObject())
545:             pkg.writeText(manifest.toString(2) + "\n", Charsets.UTF_8)
546:         }
547:         return Result(0, cap(out.toString()))
548:     }
549: 
550:     private fun npmRun(args: List<String>, dir: File, timeoutMs: Long): Result {
551:         val pkg = File(dir, "package.json")
552:         if (!pkg.isFile) return Result(1, "npm run: нет package.json в текущем каталоге\n")
553:         val manifest = org.json.JSONObject(pkg.readText(Charsets.UTF_8))
554:         val scripts = manifest.optJSONObject("scripts")
555:             ?: return Result(1, "npm run: в package.json нет секции scripts\n")
556:         val script = args.firstOrNull()
557:             ?: return Result(0, "доступные скрипты:\n" + scripts.keys().asSequence().joinToString("\n") { "  $it" } + "\n")
558:         val cmd = scripts.optString(script).takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
559:             ?: return Result(1, "npm run: нет скрипта \"$script\" (есть: ${scripts.keys().asSequence().joinToString(", ")})\n")
560:         val r = execute(cmd, dir, timeoutMs)
561:         return Result(r.exitCode, r.output)
562:     }

567:         if (local != null) {
568:             out.append("локальные (node_modules):\n")

15: class Instructions(private val workspace: Workspace) {
16: 
17:     /** Global `~/.config/opencode` analog. */

20:     data class Result(val text: String, val sources: List<String>)
21: 
22:     /**
23:      * Collects instructions for [projectDir]: project AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md),
24:      * walking up to the workspace root; then the global one; then every entry
25:      * of the config `instructions` list (local paths relative to the project
26:      * or the workspace, and http(s) URLs).
27:      */
28:     fun collect(projectDir: File?): Result {
29:         val parts = mutableListOf<Pair<String, String>>() // source → text
30: 
31:         // 1. project rules, nearest first (AGENTS.md wins over CLAUDE.md per directory)
32:         var dir = projectDir
33:         val chain = mutableListOf<File>()
34:         while (dir != null && dir.startsWith(workspace.root) && chain.size < 8) {
35:             chain += dir
36:             dir = dir.parentFile
37:         }
38:         for (d in chain.reversed()) {
39:             val f = ruleFile(d) ?: continue
40:             val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8).trim()
41:             if (text.isNotEmpty()) parts += workspace.relativeTo(f) to text
42:         }
43: 
44:         // 2. global rules
45:         val global = ruleFile(globalDir)?.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)?.trim()
46:         if (!global.isNullOrEmpty()) parts += workspace.relativeTo(ruleFile(globalDir)!!) to global
47: 
48:         // 3. instructions from config
49:         for (entry in configInstructions()) {
50:             if (entry.startsWith("http://") || entry.startsWith("https://")) {
51:                 fetchRemote(entry)?.let { parts += entry to it }
52:             } else {
53:                 val f = resolveInstructionPath(entry, projectDir) ?: continue
54:                 if (f.isFile) {
55:                     val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8).trim()
56:                     if (text.isNotEmpty()) parts += workspace.relativeTo(f) to text
57:                 }
58:             }
59:         }
60: 
61:         if (parts.isEmpty()) return Result("", emptyList())
62:         val text = parts.joinToString("\n\n") { "# ${it.first}\n\n${it.second}" }
63:         return Result(text, parts.map { it.first })
64:     }
65: 
66:     /** AGENTS.md, or CLAUDE.md when AGENTS.md is absent (Claude Code compat). */
67:     private fun ruleFile(dir: File): File? {
68:         val agents = File(dir, "AGENTS.md")
69:         if (agents.isFile) return agents
70:         val claude = File(dir, "CLAUDE.md")
71:         if (claude.isFile) return claude
72:         return null
73:     }

89:     private fun resolveInstructionPath(entry: String, projectDir: File?): File? {
90:         if (entry.endsWith("/*") || entry.endsWith("/*.md")) {
91:             val parent = entry.removeSuffix("*").removeSuffix("/")
92:             val base = workspace.resolve(parent, projectDir ?: workspace.root) ?: return null
93:             if (!base.isDirectory) return null

display.text:
package dev.pocketrun.agent

import android.content.Context

/**
 * Agent configuration, stored in SharedPreferences. Works with any
 * OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq,
 * Together, a local llama.cpp/vLLM server on the Wi-Fi network, …
 *
 * Also carries the agent-behaviour knobs (permission mode, max rounds) and
 * the optional GitHub token used by the `github` tool.
 */
object AgentSettings {

    const val DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
    const val DEFAULT_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"

    /** opencode Zen: the curated OpenAI-compatible gateway from opencode.ai/auth. */
    const val ZEN_BASE_URL = "https://opencode.ai/zen/v1"
    const val ZEN_AUTH_URL = "https://opencode.ai/auth"

    /** Where the user creates a GitHub PAT (scopes: repo, workflow). */
    const val GITHUB_TOKEN_URL = "https://github.com/settings/tokens/new?scopes=repo,workflow&description=PocketRun"
    const val GITHUB_API = "https://api.github.com"

    /** Permission modes for tool execution. */
    const val MODE_AUTO = "auto"     // everything runs without asking
    const val MODE_MANUAL = "manual" // mutations need a tap; reads run freely
    const val MODE_ASK = "ask"       // the agent asks clarifying questions first
    val MODES = listOf(MODE_AUTO, MODE_MANUAL, MODE_ASK)
    val MODE_LABELS = mapOf(MODE_AUTO to "Авто", MODE_MANUAL to "Вручную", MODE_ASK to "Вопросы")

    /**
     * Model rounds per user request. Each round is one model call plus the
     * tools it asked for, so a real task (edit a project, push it, wait for the
     * CI run, fix what broke) needs dozens of them — the old default of 12
     * stopped agents in the middle of ordinary work.
     */
    const val DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS = 40
    const val MAX_STEPS_LIMIT = 500

    /** Ready-made presets shown in the model settings dialog. */
    data class Preset(val label: String, val baseUrl: String, val model: String)

    val PRESETS = listOf(
        Preset("OpenCode Zen", ZEN_BASE_URL, "claude-sonnet-4-5"),
        Preset("OpenAI", "https://api.openai.com/v1", "gpt-4o-mini"),
        Preset("OpenRouter", "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1", "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5"),
        Preset("Groq", "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1", "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"),
    )

    data class Config(
        val baseUrl: String = DEFAULT_BASE_URL,
        val apiKey: String = "",
        val model: String = DEFAULT_MODEL,
        val githubToken: String = "",
        val confirmMode: String = MODE_AUTO,
        val maxSteps: Int = DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS,
    ) {
        /**
         * The API key is optional: local servers (llama.cpp, vLLM) need none,
         * and for Zen the server itself answers 403 without one — which the
         * agent surfaces with a hint. Only URL and model are required.
         */
        val isReady: Boolean get() = baseUrl.isNotBlank() && model.isNotBlank()
        val endpoint: String get() = baseUrl.trimEnd('/') + "/chat/completions"
        val isZen: Boolean get() = baseUrl.contains("opencode.ai/zen")
        val hasGitHub: Boolean get() = githubToken.isNotBlank()
        val safeMaxSteps: Int get() = maxSteps.coerceIn(1, MAX_STEPS_LIMIT)
    }

    private const val PREFS = "agent"

    fun read(context: Context): Config {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        return Config(
            baseUrl = prefs.getString("baseUrl", DEFAULT_BASE_URL)!!.trim().trimEnd('/').ifBlank { DEFAULT_BASE_URL },
            apiKey = prefs.getString("apiKey", "")!!.trim(),
            model = prefs.getString("model", DEFAULT_MODEL)!!.trim().ifBlank { DEFAULT_MODEL },
            githubToken = prefs.getString("githubToken", "")!!.trim(),
            confirmMode = prefs.getString("confirmMode", MODE_AUTO)!!.trim().let { if (it in MODES) it else MODE_AUTO },
            maxSteps = prefs.getString("maxSteps", DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS.toString())!!.trim().toIntOrNull() ?: DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS,
        )
    }

    fun save(context: Context, config: Config) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putString("baseUrl", config.baseUrl.trim().trimEnd('/'))
            .putString("apiKey", config.apiKey.trim())
            .putString("model", config.model.trim())
            .putString("githubToken", config.githubToken.trim())
            .putString("confirmMode", config.confirmMode)
            .putString("maxSteps", config.safeMaxSteps.toString())
            .apply()
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- ui state

    /**
     * Which session tab was active and which tabs were open, so the agent
     * chat comes back exactly as it was after the app is closed. Returns null
     * when nothing was saved yet (first launch → continue the latest session).
     */
    data class UiState(val lastSessionId: String?, val openTabs: List<String>)

    fun readUiState(context: Context): UiState? {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        if (!prefs.contains("uiOpenTabs")) return null
        val last = prefs.getString("uiLastSessionId", "")!!.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
        val tabs = prefs.getString("uiOpenTabs", "")!!.split(',').filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        return UiState(last, tabs)
    }

    fun saveUiState(context: Context, lastSessionId: String?, openTabs: List<String>) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putString("uiLastSessionId", lastSessionId ?: "")
            .putString("uiOpenTabs", openTabs.joinToString(","))
            .apply()
    }
}

# Tools

Manage the tools an LLM can use.

Tools allow the LLM to perform actions in your codebase. OpenCode comes with a set of built-in tools, but you can extend it with [custom tools](/docs/custom-tools) or [MCP servers](/docs/mcp-servers).

By default, all tools are **enabled** and don’t need permission to run. You can control tool behavior through [permissions](/docs/permissions).

---

## [Configure](#configure)

Use the `permission` field to control tool behavior. You can allow, deny, or require approval for each tool.

opencode.json

```
{  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",  "permission": {    "edit": "deny",    "bash": "ask",    "webfetch": "allow"  }}
```

You can also use wildcards to control multiple tools at once. For example, to require approval for all tools from an MCP server:

opencode.json

```
{  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",  "permission": {    "mymcp_*": "ask"  }}
```

[Learn more](/docs/permissions) about configuring permissions.

---

## [Built-in](#built-in)

Here are all the built-in tools available in OpenCode.

---

### [bash](#bash)

Execute shell commands in your project environment.

opencode.json

```
{  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",  "permission": {    "bash": "allow"  }}
```

This tool allows the LLM to run terminal commands like `npm install`, `git status`, or any other shell command.

---

### [edit](#edit)

Modify existing files using exact string replacements.

opencode.json

```
{  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",  "permission": {    "edit": "allow"  }}
```

This tool performs precise edits to files by replacing exact text matches. It’s the primary way the LLM modifies code.

---

### [write](#write)

Create new files or overwrite existing ones.

opencode.json

```
{  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",  "permission": {    "edit": "allow"  }}
```

Use this to allow the LLM to create new files. It will overwrite existing files if they already exist.

Note

The `write` tool is controlled by the `edit` permission, which covers all file modifications (`edit`, `write`, `apply_patch`).

---

### [read](#read)

Read file contents from your codebase.

opencode.json

```
{  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",  "permission": {    "read": "allow"  }}
```

This tool reads files and returns their contents. It supports reading specific line ranges for large files.

---

### [grep](#grep)

Search file contents using regular expressions.

opencode.json

```
{  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",  "permission": {    "grep": "allow"  }}
```

Fast content search across your codebase. Supports full regex syntax and file pattern filtering.

---

### [glob](#glob)

Find files by pattern matching.

opencode.json

```
{  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",  "permission": {    "glob": "allow"  }}
```

Search for files using glob patterns like `**/*.js` or `src/**/*.ts`. Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

---

### [lsp (experimental)](#lsp-experimental)

Interact with your configured LSP servers to get code intelligence features like definitions, references, hover info, and call hierarchy.

Note

This tool is only available when `OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_LSP_TOOL=true` (or `OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL=true`).

opencode.json

```
{  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",  "permission": {    "lsp": "allow"  }}
```

Supported operations include `goToDefinition`, `findReferences`, `hover`, `documentSymbol`, `workspaceSymbol`, `goToImplementation`, `prepareCallHierarchy`, `incomingCalls`, and `outgoingCalls`.

To configure which LSP servers are available for your project, see [LSP Servers](/docs/lsp).

---

### [apply\_patch](#apply_patch)

Apply patches to files.

opencode.json

```
{  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",  "permission": {    "edit": "allow"  }}
```

This tool applies patch files to your codebase. Useful for applying diffs and patches from various sources.

When handling `tool.execute.before` or `tool.execute.after` hooks, check `input.tool === "apply_patch"` (not `"patch"`).

`apply_patch` uses `output.args.patchText` instead of `output.args.filePath`. Paths are embedded in marker lines within `patchText` and are relative to the project root (for example: `*** Add File: src/new-file.ts`, `*** Update File: src/existing.ts`, `*** Move to: src/renamed.ts`, `*** Delete File: src/obsolete.ts`).

Note

The `apply_patch` tool is controlled by the `edit` permission, which covers all file modifications (`edit`, `write`, `apply_patch`).

---

### [skill](#skill)

Load a [skill](/docs/skills) (a `SKILL.md` file) and return its content in the conversation.

opencode.json

```
{  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",  "permission": {    "skill": "allow"  }}
```

---

### [webfetch](#webfetch)

Fetch web content.

opencode.json

```
{  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",  "permission": {    "webfetch": "allow"  }}
```

Allows the LLM to fetch and read web pages. Useful for looking up documentation or researching online resources.

---

### [websearch](#websearch)

Search the web for information.

Note

This tool is only available when using the OpenCode or OpenCode Go provider, or when either the `OPENCODE_ENABLE_EXA` or `OPENCODE_ENABLE_PARALLEL` environment variable is set to any truthy value (e.g., `true` or `1`).

To enable when launching OpenCode:

Terminal window

```
OPENCODE_ENABLE_EXA=1 opencode# orOPENCODE_ENABLE_PARALLEL=1 opencode
```

opencode.json

```
{  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",  "permission": {    "websearch": "allow"  }}
```

Performs web searches using Exa or Parallel to find relevant information online. Useful for researching topics, finding current events, or gathering information beyond the training data cutoff.

No API key is required — the tool connects directly to the backend’s hosted MCP service without authentication.

Tip

Use `websearch` when you need to find information (discovery), and `webfetch` when you need to retrieve content from a specific URL (retrieval).

---

### [question](#question)

Ask the user questions during execution.

opencode.json

```
{  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",  "permission": {    "question": "allow"  }}
```

This tool allows the LLM to ask the user questions during a task. It’s useful for:

-   Gathering user preferences or requirements
-   Clarifying ambiguous instructions
-   Getting decisions on implementation choices
-   Offering choices about what direction to take

Each question includes a header, the question text, and a list of options. Users can select from the provided options or type a custom answer. When there are multiple questions, users can navigate between them before submitting all answers.

---

## [Custom tools](#custom-tools)

Custom tools let you define your own functions that the LLM can call. These are defined in your config file and can execute arbitrary code.

[Learn more](/docs/custom-tools) about creating custom tools.

---

## [MCP servers](#mcp-servers)

MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers allow you to integrate external tools and services. This includes database access, API integrations, and third-party services.

[Learn more](/docs/mcp-servers) about configuring MCP servers.

---

## [Internals](#internals)

Internally, tools like `grep` and `glob` use [ripgrep](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep) under the hood. By default, ripgrep respects `.gitignore` patterns, which means files and directories listed in your `.gitignore` will be excluded from searches and listings.

---

### [Ignore patterns](#ignore-patterns)

To include files that would normally be ignored, create a `.ignore` file in your project root. This file can explicitly allow certain paths.

.ignore

```
!node_modules/!dist/!build/
```

For example, this `.ignore` file allows ripgrep to search within `node_modules/`, `dist/`, and `build/` directories even if they’re listed in `.gitignore`.

321:         var sawChunk = false
322:         while (true) {

324:             val line = reader.readLine() ?: break
325:             if (line.isBlank()) continue

327:                 sawChunk = true
328:                 val payload = line.removePrefix(SSE_DATA).trim()

360:             if (isCancelled()) throw LlmException(CANCELLED)
361:             try {
362:                 Thread.sleep(250)
363:             } catch (e: InterruptedException) {
364:                 Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
365:                 throw LlmException(CANCELLED)
366:             }
367:         }
368:     }

372:      * read timeout is a per-read value, so a server that stops mid-answer would
373:      * otherwise hold the turn for the full deadline.
374:      */

376:         private val lastData = AtomicLong(System.currentTimeMillis())
377:         private val gotData = AtomicBoolean(false)

379:         /** True when the watchdog, not the server, ended the connection. */
380:         @Volatile
381:         var fired: Boolean = false
382: 
383:         @Volatile
384:         private var stopped: Boolean = false
385: 
386:         fun start() {
387:             Thread({
388:                 while (!stopped) {
389:                     Thread.sleep(2_000)
390:                     if (stopped) return@Thread
391:                     val idle = System.currentTimeMillis() - lastData.get()
392:                     val limit = if (gotData.get()) STALL_TIMEOUT_MS else FIRST_TOKEN_TIMEOUT_MS
393:                     if (idle > limit) {
394:                         fired = true
395:                         runCatching { conn.disconnect() }
396:                         return@Thread
397:                     }
398:                 }
399:             }, "llm-watchdog").apply {
400:                 isDaemon = true
401:                 start()
402:             }
403:         }
404: 
405:         /** Called for every piece of data that arrived. */
406:         fun beat() {
407:             lastData.set(System.currentTimeMillis())
408:             gotData.set(true)
409:         }

parts.text:
Now I understand the current architecture:

- Single `agentExecutor` (single thread) — only one agent turn at a time.
- Single `_agentMessages`, `_currentSession`, `_todos`, `_agentRunning`, `_modelPreview`, `_pendingQuestion`, `_pendingApproval`, `_agentSteps`, `_agentRounds` — all global, tied to whatever session is current.
- `_openTabs` is a list of SessionInfo, but switching tabs just loads a session into the same single chat state.
- The `agentCancelled` flag is global.

Goal: multisessions with parallel turns. This is a significant refactor: per-session run state, multiple executors (or a pool), per-session cancellation, per-session pending question/approval, plus UI showing tabs with running indicators.

Design approach: Introduce a `SessionRuntime` (or `AgentTurn`) per session that holds its own mutable state: messages, running flag, modelPreview, steps, rounds, pendingQuestion, pendingApproval, cancel flag, executor. The ViewModel exposes the active session's state derived from the current tab. All `_agentMessages` etc. become computed from the active runtime. But Compose collects StateFlows; we need the active session's flow to be exposed.

Simplest robust approach: keep a `MutableStateFlow<Map<String, SessionState>>` keyed by session id, and expose derived StateFlows for the active session. Or, expose a single `agentState: StateFlow<AgentUiState>` that flattens the active session. Let me think about Compose usage: AgentScreen collects `viewModel.agentMessages`, `agentRunning`, `todos`, etc. If I change these to derived flows that depend on the active tab, the screen updates when switching. That's fine.

Let me design:

```kotlin
class SessionRun(
    val id: String,
    val info: Sessions.SessionInfo,
    val projectDir: File?,
) {
    val messages = MutableStateFlow<List<AgentItem>>(emptyList())
    val todos = MutableStateFlow<List<Sessions.Todo>>(emptyList())
    val running = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val preview = MutableStateFlow("")
    val steps = MutableStateFlow(0)
    val rounds = MutableStateFlow(0)
    val startedAt = MutableStateFlow(0L)
    val cancelled = AtomicBoolean(false)
    val pendingQuestion = MutableStateFlow<PendingQuestion?>(null)
    val pendingApproval = MutableStateFlow<PendingApproval?>(null)
    // history JSONArray guarded by a lock
    @Volatile var messages: JSONArray
}
```

Then ViewModel maintains `_runs = MutableStateFlow<Map<String, SessionRun>>` and `_activeId`. Expose `agentMessages = derived active run.messages`, etc. Compose needs StateFlow; use `flatMapLatest`? That requires coroutines scope. Alternatively use a helper: whenever active run changes, update public `_agentMessages` etc. But with parallel runs, background run events would write to a non-active run; the active public flow only reflects active. We can implement by having each SessionRun carry its own flows and expose active via a derived StateFlow using `combine(_runs, _activeId)` then `.map`. But `map` returns a Flow, not StateFlow. Compose `collectAsState` works with Flow too, so we can expose `Flow<List<AgentItem>>`. But existing code uses `_agentMessages.value` in methods and tests? Let me check tests referencing ViewModel. There's no AppViewModel test. UI uses collectAsState probably.

Simplest and least disruptive: keep the public `MutableStateFlow`s as the "view" of the active session, and when switching tabs, copy the active run's state into them. And when a background run emits events, if it's the active run, update public flows; also store into run state. When switching to a session that is running, copy its state into public flows and then live updates from that run flow in.

But a cleaner method: make each run's event handler write both to the run's own state and, if run.id == current, to the public state. To avoid duplication, I can have the run state be the source of truth and have the ViewModel observe.

Hmm, this is getting complex. Let me consider scope realistically. Implementing fully parallel multisession with per-session state is a large refactor. I must be careful to keep it compiling and not break existing UI.

Given constraints (no local Android build), I must be extra careful. Let me check if the project can build at all locally. Let me check for network/SDK. Actually CI does it. I can at least compile Kotlin? Unlikely.

Let me look at AgentScreen to understand UI needs, and check if there's a build I can run. Let me also verify gradle availability and network.

Given the risk, maybe I should implement in a way that's testable via the JVM unit tests (there are agent tests). The ViewModel isn't unit-tested (Android deps). But OpenCodeAgent and tools are.

Actually, the multisession concurrency mostly lives in the ViewModel. Hard to test in CI beyond compile. Hmm.

Let me reconsider: maybe a pragmatic implementation:
1. Extract a `SessionRun` class that encapsulates everything for one session's turn (tools, agent, state, cancel flag) — put it in `agent/` package (JVM-testable-ish, but it uses OpenCodeAgent/OpenCodeTools which are fine).
2. Change `agentExecutor` from single-thread to a small fixed pool (e.g., 4 threads) so multiple turns run concurrently.
3. Make run state per-session; public flows reflect the active session.
4. Add `task` tool: spawns a subagent session, runs OpenCodeAgent to completion synchronously within the parent's thread (that's the subagent), returns the final text. This is straightforward and opencode-like. But the user wants "at any moment give another task and it opens another session and works in parallel". That's the UI-level behavior: sending a message while a session is running → create a new session/tab and run there in parallel. So `sendToAgent` should, when busy (or when the user chooses "new task"), create a new session and run. The user said "он сам откроет другую сессию" — the agent opens it. But mechanically it's the app that opens a new session because a new task arrived while busy. Hmm, "он сам" could mean automatically without the user pressing "new tab". So: if the user sends a new task while the current session is running, the app automatically creates a new session (tab) and starts the turn there, rather than queueing in the same session. That matches "agent opens another session itself".

Wait, but each session already has its own tab; if the current session is busy, sending a message in that same chat should arguably continue that session. The user wants new task = new session. How does the app know it's a "different task"? Heuristic: if the current session is busy, a newly typed message is a new task → new session. If idle, it continues current. That seems reasonable and matches the request.

Alternatively provide an explicit control. But user said automatically. Let me implement: when `sendToAgent` is called and the active session is currently running, and the message isn't a chat command, create a new session (new tab), make it active, and run the turn there. The old one keeps running in the background. The user can switch tabs.

That's actually elegant and uses the per-session run state.

Also the `task` tool for subagents: opencode's task tool spawns a subagent. The user chose "parallel" semantics for the "another task" behavior, but also asked for `task`/субагенты in phase 1. I'll implement both:
- `task` tool: creates a child session (subagent), runs it to completion sequentially inside the parent turn, returns the summary. Add `parentID` linking. UI can show it (optional).
- Parallel new-task-in-new-session at UI level.

The UI only reads these flows. Good. The main refactor is in AppViewModel: make state per-session.

Let me plan the architecture concretely to minimize risk while enabling parallel sessions.

Approach: Introduce a `SessionRun` holder per session id, stored in a map. Public flows become derived from the active run. Since Compose collects the public StateFlows, I can maintain public flows and update them whenever (a) active session changes, or (b) an event arrives for the active run. Keep run-internal state as the source of truth for background runs.

Implementation detail: I'll create:

```kotlin
inner class SessionRun(val id: String, val projectDir: File?) {
    val messages = MutableStateFlow<List<AgentItem>>(emptyList())
    val todos = MutableStateFlow<List<Sessions.Todo>>(emptyList())
    val running = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val preview = MutableStateFlow("")
    val steps = MutableStateFlow(0)
    val rounds = MutableStateFlow(0)
    val startedAt = MutableStateFlow(0L)
    val pendingQuestion = MutableStateFlow<PendingQuestion?>(null)
    val pendingApproval = MutableStateFlow<PendingApproval?>(null)
    val cancelled = AtomicBoolean(false)
    @Volatile var history: JSONArray = JSONArray()
}
```

Then in ViewModel:
```kotlin
private val runs = ConcurrentHashMap<String, SessionRun>()
private val active = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
```

Public flows:
```kotlin
val agentMessages: StateFlow<List<AgentItem>> = activeRunFlow(run -> run.messages) ...
```
But this returns a Flow. To keep StateFlow type, existing UI uses `.collectAsState()` which accepts Flow. But existing ViewModel code reads `_agentMessages.value`. If I remove `_agentMessages`, I must update all internal references. Alternatively keep `_agentMessages` as the public active mirror and update it from active run changes. But mirroring requires observing flows (coroutines). Hmm.

Simplest: Provide public state as a single `data class AgentUiState` and expose `agentState: StateFlow<AgentUiState>`, then keep backward-compatible getters? But UI uses `viewModel.agentMessages`. Changing UI is fine (I can edit AgentScreen). But minimizing edits is good.

Alternative simpler approach that avoids flow plumbing: use one shared "projection" into the existing public MutableStateFlows, updated explicitly. I.e., keep `_agentMessages`, `_agentRunning`, etc. as the *active session's* view. Add per-session stored state in `SessionRun`. Whenever an event occurs for a run:
- Always write into `run`'s own plain fields (not flows).
- If `run.id == active`, also write to the public flows.
When switching active session, call `project(run)` which sets all public flows from run state.

But `SessionRun` fields being plain + public flows update logic is duplication. Manageable but error-prone.

Better: make `SessionRun` hold StateFlows, and make the active projection a coroutine that collects. Actually, Compose can collect the active flow if I expose it as `Flow`. Let me change UI to use a single derived flow. But there is a lot in AgentScreen using these. Let me look at AgentScreen around those lines to judge.

Actually the cleanest and idiomatic: 
```kotlin
private val _activeRun = MutableStateFlow<SessionRun?>(null)
val agentMessages: StateFlow<List<AgentItem>> = _activeRun.flatMapLatest { it?.messages ?: flowOf(emptyList()) }.stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.Eagerly, emptyList())
```
This requires `viewModelScope` (AndroidViewModel has it), coroutines `flatMapLatest`, `stateIn`, `SharingStarted`. kotlinx-coroutines is available (they use StateFlow). flatMapLatest is in kotlinx.coroutines.flow. stateIn needs a CoroutineScope. viewModelScope is from lifecycle-viewmodel-ktx. Is it a dependency? They use AndroidViewModel but maybe not viewModelScope. Let me check build.gradle dependencies.

Actually simpler: use `combine`? flatMapLatest is best.

But `stateIn` with Eagerly creates the derived StateFlows once. That works. However, `SessionRun` flows are created per session. `_activeRun` changes when switching. This is clean.

Let me check build.gradle for coroutines/lifecycle deps.

        private const val MAX_READ = 16 * 1024 * 1024
        private const val MAX_HTTP_BODY = 4 * 1024 * 1024
        const val VERSION = "Rhino 1.8.1 (ES6,interpreted)"
    }

    override val kind: RuntimeKind = RuntimeKind.NODE
    override val version: String = VERSION
    override fun isAvailable(): Boolean = true

     private fun base(): File = projectDir ?: workspace.root
 
     private fun doBash(args: JSONObject): String {
         val command = args.getString("command")

         val r = shell.execute(command, base(), timeout)
         val out = buildString {
             append("exit code: ").append(r.exitCode).append('\n')
             if (r.output.isNotBlank()) append(r.output.trimEnd()).append('\n')
         }
         return out.trim().take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT)
     }
 
     private fun doRead(args: JSONObject): String {
         val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         if (!f.exists()) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
         if (f.isDirectory) return "error: это каталог, используйте list"
         val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
         val offset = args.optInt("offset", 1).coerceAtLeast(1)
         val limit = args.optInt("limit", 0)
         val lines = text.lines()
         val from = (offset - 1).coerceIn(0, lines.size)
         val to = if (limit > 0) minOf(from + limit, lines.size) else lines.size
         val picked = lines.subList(from, to)
         val body = picked.joinToString("\n")
         return (body.take(MAX_READ) + if (body.length > MAX_READ) "\n… (обрезано)" else "")
             .ifEmpty { "(пустой файл)" }
     }
 
     private fun doWrite(args: JSONObject): String {
         val path = args.getString("filePath")
         if (path.isBlank()) return "error: пустой путь"
         val f = resolve(path) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         f.parentFile?.mkdirs()
         f.writeText(args.optString("content", ""), Charsets.UTF_8)
         return "wrote ${args.optString("content", "").length} chars to ${workspace.relativeTo(f)}"
     }
 
     private fun doEdit(args: JSONObject): String {
         val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         if (!f.isFile) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
         val old = args.getString("oldString")
         val new = args.optString("newString", "")
         if (old.isEmpty()) return "error: oldString пуст"
         val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
         val count = countOccurrences(text, old)
         if (count == 0) return "error: oldString не найден в файле"
         if (count > 1 && !args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) {
             return "error: oldString встречается $count раз — уточните текст или передайте replaceAll: true"
         }
         val updated = if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) text.replace(old, new) else text.replaceFirst(old, new)
         f.writeText(updated, Charsets.UTF_8)
         return "ok: заменено вхождений: ${if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) count else 1}"
     }
 
     private fun doList(args: JSONObject): String {
         val path = args.optString("path", ".")
         val dir = resolve(path) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         if (!dir.exists()) return "error: нет такого каталога: $path"
         if (!dir.isDirectory) return "error: не каталог: $path"
         val entries = dir.listFiles()?.sortedWith(compareByDescending<File> { it.isDirectory }.thenBy { it.name }) ?: return "(empty)"
         if (entries.isEmpty()) return "(empty)"
         return entries.take(200).joinToString("\n") { f -> if (f.isDirectory) f.name + "/" else f.name + " (${f.length()} bytes)" }
     }
 
     private fun doGlob(args: JSONObject): String {
         val pattern = args.getString("pattern")
         val dir = resolve(args.optString("path", ".")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         val base = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory } ?: workspace.root
         val matches = mutableListOf<File>()
         base.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
             if (f.isFile) {
                 val rel = f.relativeToOrNull(base)?.path ?: return@forEach
                 if (globToRegex(pattern).matches(rel)) matches += f
             }
         }
         if (matches.isEmpty()) return "(нет совпадений)"
         return matches.sortedByDescending { it.lastModified() }
             .take(200)
             .joinToString("\n") { workspace.relativeTo(it) }
     }
 
     private fun doGrep(args: JSONObject): String {
         val pattern = try { Regex(args.getString("pattern")) } catch (t: Throwable) { return "error: плохой regex: ${t.message}" }
         val dir = resolve(args.optString("path", ".")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         val base = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory } ?: workspace.root
         val include = args.optString("include").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { globToRegex(it) }
         val out = StringBuilder()
         base.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
             if (out.length > MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT) return@forEach
             if (!f.isFile || f.length() > 512 * 1024) return@forEach
             val rel = workspace.relativeTo(f)
             if (include != null && !include.matches(f.name) && !include.matches(rel)) return@forEach
             val text = runCatching { f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) }.getOrNull() ?: return@forEach
             text.lines().forEachIndexed { idx, line ->
                 if (pattern.containsMatchIn(line)) out.append("$rel:${idx + 1}: ${line.take(300)}\n")
             }
         }
         return out.toString().trim().take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT).ifEmpty { "(нет совпадений)" }
     }
 
     private fun doApplyPatch(args: JSONObject): String {
         return try {
             val result = ApplyPatch.apply(args.getString("patchText")) { path -> resolve(path) }
             buildString {
                 if (result.applied.isNotEmpty()) appendLine(result.applied.joinToString("\n"))
                 if (result.skipped.isNotEmpty()) appendLine("skipped: " + result.skipped.joinToString("; "))
             }.trim().ifEmpty { "патч не содержал операций" }
         } catch (e: ApplyPatch.PatchException) {
             "error: ${e.message}"
         }
     }
 
     private fun doTodoWrite(args: JSONObject): String {
         val arr = args.optJSONArray("todos") ?: return "error: нужен массив todos"
         val list = mutableListOf<Sessions.Todo>()
         for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
             val o = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
             val content = o.optString("content")
             if (content.isEmpty()) continue
             val status = o.optString("status", "pending")
             list += Sessions.Todo(
                 id = o.optString("id").ifEmpty { "t$i" },
                 content = content,
                 status = if (status in listOf("pending", "in_progress", "completed")) status else "pending",
             )
         }
         todos = list
         onTodos?.invoke(list)
         return "todos updated: ${list.size}"
     }
 
     private fun doWebFetch(args: JSONObject): String {
         val url = args.getString("url")
         if (!url.startsWith("http://") && !url.startsWith("https://")) return "error: только http(s) URL"
         return try {
             val conn = URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
             conn.connectTimeout = 10_000
             conn.readTimeout = 30_000
             conn.instanceFollowRedirects = true
             conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; PocketRunAgent/1.3)")
             val status = conn.responseCode
             val body = (if (status in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream)
                 ?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() } ?: ""
             if (status !in 200..299) return "HTTP $status: ${body.take(300)}"
             val text = stripHtml(body)
             text.take(MAX_WEB).ifEmpty { "(пустой ответ)" }
         } catch (t: Throwable) {
             "error: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}"
         }
     }
 
     private fun doSkill(args: JSONObject): String {
         val name = args.getString("name")
         val skill = skills.load(name, projectDir)
             ?: return "error: навык '$name' не найден. Доступны: ${skills.discover(projectDir).joinToString(", ") { it.name }.ifEmpty { "(нет)" }}"
         return skill.content.take(32 * 1024)
     }
 
     private fun doQuestion(args: JSONObject): String {
         val arr = args.optJSONArray("questions") ?: return "error: нужен массив questions"
         val questions = mutableListOf<Question>()
         for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {

                 "logs" -> gh.logs(args.getString("repo"), args.getLong("run_id"))
                 "artifacts" -> gh.artifacts(args.getString("repo"), args.optLong("run_id", 0).takeIf { it != 0L })

     private fun resolve(path: String): File? = workspace.resolve(path, base())
 
     private fun countOccurrences(text: String, needle: String): Int {
         var count = 0
         var idx = 0
         while (true) {
             idx = text.indexOf(needle, idx)
             if (idx < 0) return count
             count++
             idx += needle.length
         }
     }
 
     private fun globToRegex(pattern: String): Regex {
         val regex = buildString {
             append('^')
             var i = 0
             while (i < pattern.length) {
                 when (val c = pattern[i]) {
                     '*' -> if (i + 1 < pattern.length && pattern[i + 1] == '*') { append(".*"); i++ } else append("[^/]*")
                     '?' -> append('.')
                     else -> if (c in "\\^$.|+()[]{}") { append('\\'); append(c) } else append(c)
                 }
                 i++
             }
             append('$')
         }
         return Regex(regex)
     }
 
     private fun stripHtml(html: String): String {
         return html
             .replace(Regex("(?is)<(script|style)[^>]*>.*?</\\1>"), " ")
             .replace(Regex("(?s)<!--.*?-->"), " ")
             .replace(Regex("(?s)<br[^>]*>|</p>|</div>|</li>"), "\n")
             .replace(Regex("(?s)<[^>]+>"), " ")
             .replace(" ", " ").replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<")
             .replace(">", ">").replace(""", "\"").replace("'", "'")
             .replace(Regex("[ \\t\\x0B\\f\\r]+"), " ")
             .replace(Regex("\\n\\s*\\n+"), "\n")
             .trim()
     }
 }

 # PocketRun — статус, архитектура и что осталось сделать
 
 Дата: 26 сентября 2026
 Репозиторий: `sj0404-collab/pocketrun` (приватный)
 CI: `.github/workflows/android.yml` — сборка APK и тесты в GitHub Actions, локальная сборка не нужна.
 
 ---
 
 ## 1. Что это
 
 Упрощённый оригинал (не аналог того, что есть в маркетплейсах) — Android-приложение
 на Kotlin, внутри которого живут:
 
 | Слой | Реализация | Состояние |
 |---|---|---|
 | Python | настоящий CPython 3.13 через Chaquopy | бутстрап + Kotlin-мост `PythonRuntime` готовы |
 | Node.js | настоящий Node 18 (nodejs-mobile) + Rhino-фолбэк | готово |
 | npx | свой: реестр npm + распаковка tar + запуск `bin` | не начато |
 | opencode | инструменты, навыки, сессии и инструкции opencode-стиля (v1.3.0) | готово |
 | Релиз-ключ | Ed25519, офлайн-проверка, утилита keygen | **готово** |
 | Интерфейс | Jetpack Compose | MVP: активация → проекты → редактор+терминал → инфо |
 
 Ключевое ограничение, определившее архитектуру: **это Android без Termux**, то есть
 нет Linux-пространства пользователя. Отсюда решения ниже.
 
 ---
 
 ## 2. Ключевые технические решения
 
 ### 2.1 Node.js: настоящий Node 18, Rhino как фолбэк
 
 `nodejs-mobile` даёт настоящий Node 18 в виде `libnode.so` (~62 МБ на ABI), но
 без исполняемого файла. Android API 29+ запрещает запускать файлы из каталога
 данных приложения, поэтому:
 
 * берём `libnode.so` из релиза nodejs-mobile v18.20.4 (arm64-v8a, x86_64);
 * собираем лаунчер `cpp/noderunner.cpp` (`node::Start(argc, argv)`), линкуем
   NDK clang'ом и упаковываем как `libnoderunner.so` прямо в `jniLibs` — Android
   извлекает `lib*.so` в `nativeLibraryDir`, откуда их можно exec'нуть;
 * `packaging.jniLibs.useLegacyPackaging = true`, иначе библиотеки не
   распакуются из APK и исполняемого файла на диске не будет;
 * `runtime/js/NodeRuntime.kt` запускает `libnoderunner.so` через
   `ProcessBuilder` на каждый скрипт: настоящий изолированный и отменяемый
   процесс; `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`, `NODE_PATH` и cwd пробрасываются.
 
 Загрузка и сборка — Gradle-задачи `fetchNodeMobile` и `assembleNodeJniLibs`
 (кэш в `android/.nodejs-mobile`). Rhino + `assets/node/boot.js` остаются
 фолбэком, когда нативный лаунчер недоступен (например, JVM-тесты). APK растёт
 примерно вдвое.
 
 ### 2.2 Python
 
 Chaquopy 17.0.0 (плагин), CPython 3.13. Версия Python выбирается блоком
 `chaquopy { defaultConfig { version = "3.13" } }` в `android/app/build.gradle.kts`;
 зависимость `com.chaquo.python:python` для этого не работает — Chaquopy 17 её
 игнорирует и молча собирает дефолтный 3.10 (так было до сентября 2026).
 Плагин не публикует marker-артефакт, поэтому в `settings.gradle.kts` есть
 `resolutionStrategy.eachPlugin` с `useModule("com.chaquo.python:gradle:...")`.
 
 Пакеты Python ставятся на этапе сборки, а не во время работы:
 
 ```kotlin
 // android/app/build.gradle.kts
 chaquopy {
     defaultConfig { /* ... */ }
 }
 dependencies { /* ... */ }
 // pip { install("requests") }
 ```
 
 Предупреждение сборки `Failed to compile to .pyc format: Couldn't find Python 3.10`
 безвредно: на машине сборки нет CPython 3.10, Chaquopy просто не предкомпилирует
 *.pyc* и интерпретирует исходники. На устройство это не влияет. С сентября 2026 в CI
 стоит `actions/setup-python` с 3.13, совпадающим с версией приложения, поэтому
 *.pyc* компилируется и это предупреждение ушло.
 
 ### 2.3 Формат лицензионного ключа
 
 Ключ выглядит так:
 
 ```
 PRK1.<base64url(payload)>.<base64url(ed25519-подпись)>
 ```
 
 `payload` — канонический текстовый документ (не JSON, чтобы подпись была
 побитово воспроизводимой):
 
 ```
 PRK1
 name=Jane Doe
 seat=work-laptop
 plan=pro
 nbf=1750000000
 exp=1760000000
 ```
 
 Подпись покрывает **байты payload**, а не пересериализованный объект. Поэтому
 проверка идёт в строгом порядке: разделить ключ → проверить подпись по байтам →
 только потом парсить поля.
 
 Отслеживания нет: срок задаётся в ключе, отзыв невозможен by design. Смена
 параметров — это смена встроенного в APK публичного ключа.
 
 Публичный ключ вшивается в сборку из `android/license.pubkey`:
 
 ```
 ./tools/keygen/gradlew -p tools/keygen run --args="genkey --out android"
 ```
 
 Если файла нет, в APK попадает заглушка `DEMO…`, и приложение честно отказывает
 любому ключу с сообщением об этом.
 
 ### 2.4 Две разные вещи под словом «релиз-ключ»
 
 1. **Ключ активации** — лицензия пользователя, проверяется офлайн (выше).
 2. **Ключ подписи APK** — `android/keystore.properties` + `release` signingConfig.
    Без него `packageRelease` падает с понятной ошибкой. В CI подпись берётся из
    секретов `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64` / `_PASSWORD` / `KEY_ALIAS` / `KEY_PASSWORD`;
    если секретов нет, собирается только debug APK.
 
 ### 2.5 Вывод в терминал
 
 Рантаймы не пишут в stdout процесса. Они пишут в два файла в
 `workspace/cache/runs/<id>/`, а `OutputTailer` следит за ними и отдаёт строки
 в UI. Причины: пайп блокирует интерпретатор при медленном читателе, файл
 переживает падение UI, и stderr можно красить отдельно. Декодирование
 инкрементальное — многобайтный UTF-8 не рвётся на границе буфера.
 
 ### 2.6 Границы песочницы
 
 `core/Workspace.kt` — единственное место, где живут пути. Корень:
 `filesDir/workspace`. Внутри: `projects/`, `packages/`, `cache/`, `logs/`.
 `Workspace.resolve()` возвращает `null`, если путь уходит наружу; вызывающий код
 трактует это как «путь отклонён», а не «файла нет».
 
 ---
 
 ## 3. Что уже написано
 
 ```
 android/app/src/main/java/dev/pocketrun/
   MainActivity.kt                     заглушка
   core/Workspace.kt                   песочница, защита от выхода за корень
   license/LicenseFormat.kt            формат ключа (копия в tools/keygen)
   license/Ed25519.kt                  чистая Java Ed25519 для API 26+
   license/LicenseVerifier.kt          чистая проверка ключа: подпись + окно времени
   license/LicenseManager.kt           SharedPreferences + StateFlow, фичи по плану
   runtime/Exec.kt                     модель выполнения, интерфейс рантайма
   runtime/OutputTailer.kt             живой вывод из файлов
 android/app/src/main/python/
   pocketrun.py                        argv, sys.path, потоки, трейсбеки, пакеты
 android/app/src/test/java/dev/pocketrun/license/
   LicenseFormatTest.kt                золотой тест-вектор, общий с keygen
 tools/keygen/                         отдельный JVM-проект: genkey/issue/verify/inspect
 .github/workflows/android.yml         сборка APK + тесты в GitHub
 ```
 
 Тест-вектор (детерминированный сид → фиксированный ключ) зафиксирован в обоих
 проектах: `tools/keygen/.../LicenseFormatTest.kt` и
 `android/app/src/test/.../LicenseFormatTest.kt`. Расхождение формата валит одну
 из сборок.
 
 ---
 
 ## 4. Что осталось
 
 Порядок именно такой — каждый пункт опирается на предыдущий.
 
 ### 4.1 Python-мост (следующий шаг) ✅ готово (v1.1.0)
 
 `runtime/python/PythonRuntime.kt`:
 * `initAsync()` стартует `Python.start(AndroidPlatform(context))` один раз, из
   `PocketRunApplication.onCreate` на фоновом потоке — старт занимает около секунды;
 * `execute()` создаёт `out_path`/`err_path` в `workspace/cache/runs/<id>`,
   поднимает два `OutputTailer`, вызывает `pocketrun.run(script, argsJson, stdin,
   out, err, cwd)`, возвращает `ExecResult`;
 * `isAvailable()` и `version()` читаются из `pocketrun.interpreter_info()`;
 * **ограничение отмены:** Chaquopy не умеет прерывать вызов. `cancel()` ставит
   флаг, и по возвращению выдаётся код 130. Убийство процесса невозможно —
   это честно показано в UI.
 
 ### 4.2 Node ✅ готово: настоящий Node 18 + Rhino-фолбэк
 
 Нативный Node (основной путь на устройстве):
 
 * `cpp/noderunner.cpp` + Gradle-задачи `fetchNodeMobile` /
   `assembleNodeJniLibs` в `android/app/build.gradle.kts` — скачивают
   nodejs-mobile v18.20.4, собирают `libnoderunner.so` под arm64-v8a и x86_64 и
   кладут рядом `libnode.so` и NDK-ный `libc++_shared.so`;
 * `runtime/js/NodeRuntime.kt` (`SyncScriptRuntime`) — `ProcessBuilder` на
   каждый запуск, реальные stdout/stderr, отмена через `destroy()`, таймаут →
   код 124; `AppViewModel.activeNode` выбирает его, когда лаунчер есть, иначе
   падает на Rhino; `MiniShell`, `NpxRuntime` и `OpenCodeTools` работают через
   интерфейс `SyncScriptRuntime`.
 
 Rhino-фолбэк (когда нативного лаунчера нет, например в JVM-тестах):
 
 * `runtime/js/JsRuntime.kt` — Rhino 1.8.1 `Context` (`VERSION_ES6`,
   `setOptimizationLevel(-1)`, `initSafeStandardObjects`), мост `__pr` на
   BaseFunction-подклассах (Kotlin null → JS null, не undefined!), event loop
   по хукам `__prRunDue/__prPending/__prNextDue/__prExitCode/__prOnExit`,
   вывод через log-файлы и OutputTailer как у Python, отмена → код 130;
 * `assets/node/boot.js` — `require` (relative/json/`node_modules`/`packages/`,
   `__dirname`, `__setMainDir` для главного скрипта), `module.exports`,
   `path`, `process`, `console`, `os`, `util`, `events`, `url`/`querystring`,
   `http(s)` (синхронный через мост, фейк-асинхронный API), `assert`,
   `stream` (Readable/Writable/Duplex/Transform/PassThrough с буферизацией,
   `pipe`, `drain`/`finish`/`end`), таймеры, `Buffer` (utf8/base64/hex,
   кириллица), полифилл `Promise`;
 * `os`/`process` отдают живые данные устройства через мост
   (`core/SystemInfo.kt`): `arch`/`release`/`hostname`/`cpus`/`totalmem`/
   `freemem`/`uptime`/`loadavg`/`networkInterfaces` (из `/proc` и `java.net`),
   `process.memoryUsage()`/`hrtime()`/`pid`; `fs.createReadStream` и
   `fs.createWriteStream` — настоящие потоки, а не заглушки;
   шебанг и `async function` срезаются при загрузке модулей;
 * песочница fs целиком на стороне моста (`Workspace.resolve`), выход за
   корень = ENOENT/EACCES;
 * проверено: десктоп-харнесс (78 кейсов) + JVM-тесты `JsRuntimeTest` в CI;
 * ограничение: нет class/async-await/import-export/spread-литералов —
   Rhino их не парсит; чистые ES5/ES6-пакеты работают.
 
 ### 4.3 npx ✅ готово (v1.2.0)
 
 * `runtime/npm/Semver.kt` — semver-парсер и диапазоны (`^`, `~`, `>= <`,
   `x`-диапазоны, `||`, prerelease-правила);
 * `runtime/npm/TarReader.kt` — распаковка `.tgz` (ustar + prefix-поле),
   защита от выхода за пределы каталога;
 * `runtime/npm/NpmRegistry.kt` — метаданные и tarball'ы с
   `registry.npmjs.org` (URLEncode для scoped, UA обязателен);
 * `runtime/npm/NpxRuntime.kt` — спецификаторы (`pkg`, `pkg@1.2.3`, `@scope/pkg@v`),
   установка в `packages/<name>` с рекурсивными зависимостями (hoist, при
   конфликте версий — вложенно в `packages/<parent>/node_modules/`), выбор
   версии (exact/range/dist-tag/max satisfying), чтение `bin`, запуск через
   JsRuntime с cwd вызывающего; кэш-first как у настоящего npx;
 * проверено вживую: `cowsay@1.4.0` (11 пакетов, кириллица, повторный запуск из
   кэша), `semver@6.3.1` (валидация и диапазоны);
 * ограничение: пакеты с class/async/import или нативными аддонами не работают —
   при parse-ошибке печатается подсказка попробовать старую версию.
 
 ### 4.4 Агент ✅ готово (v1.3.0 — opencode-совместимый)
 
 * `agent/opencode/OpenCodeTools.kt` — инструменты opencode: `bash`, `read`,
   `write`, `edit`, `list`, `glob`, `grep`, `apply_patch`, `todowrite`,
   `webfetch`, `skill`, `question` (без `lsp`/`websearch`);
 * `agent/opencode/MiniShell.kt` — мини-шелл для `bash`: ~26 встроенных команд,
   кавычки, `&&`, `|`, `>` `>>`, плюс `python`/`node`/`npx` через рантаймы и
   настоящий BusyBox 1.34.1 (`runtime/shell/Busybox.kt`, собран для Android
   из F-Droid meefik/busybox, кладётся в jniLibs как `libbusybox.so`):
   любой applet работает как реальный бинарник — sed, awk, sort, uniq, cut,
   tr, tar, gzip, xargs, diff, wget и т.д.; они не ограничены песочницей;
 * `agent/opencode/ApplyPatch.kt` — формат `*** Begin Patch` (Add/Update/Move
   to/Delete File), толерантный к отступам и diff-стилю контекста;
 * `agent/opencode/Skills.kt` — SKILL.md-навыки: проект `.opencode/.claude/.agents

 * `agent/opencode/Sessions.kt` — сессии `opencode-data/sessions/<id>.json`:
   create/list/load/save/rename/fork/latest/export, todos;
 * `agent/opencode/Instructions.kt` — AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md (проект + глобальный),
   `instructions` из `opencode/opencode.json` (файлы и URL, 5 с);
 * `agent/opencode/OpenCodeAgent.kt` — цикл ≤12 шагов, системный промпт
   opencode-стиля (правила + инструкции + todos);
 * `agent/AgentSettings.kt` — пресеты (OpenCode Zen, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq);
 * `agent/LlmClient.kt` — `/chat/completions` + `models()` (GET /models) для
   живого списка моделей (в Zen 80+);
 * UI: панель сессий (resume/fork/rename/export/delete), панель todos,
   интерактивные карточки `question`, команды `/new` и `/init`;
 * доступен только для планов с `canUseAgent` (pro) — гейт в UI и в ViewModel.
 
 ### 4.5 Интерфейс
 
 Экраны: активация → список проектов → редактор + терминал → чат агента →
 пакеты. `MainActivity` сейчас заглушка.
 
+### 4.6 Параллельные сессии и субагенты ✅ готово
+
+* `AppViewModel.SessionRun` — состояние одного хода (сообщения, todos,
+  счётчики, вопрос/подтверждение, отмена), вынесено из общих полей; публичные
+  `agentMessages`/`agentRunning`/… — это производные потоки от активной вкладки
+  (`activeFlow` через `flatMapLatest`), плюс `runningSessionIds` для индикатора на
+  вкладках;
+* несколько сессий работают одновременно: `agentExecutor` — пул из
+  `MAX_PARALLEL_TURNS` (4) потоков; `performTurn` синхронный, поэтому его же
+  вызывает и субагент;
+* новое задание на занятой вкладке (`sendToAgent`, `attachFile`) не встаёт в
+  очередь, а открывает свою сессию (`createSession`) и стартует там параллельно;
+  вкладки можно переключать и закрывать на ходу, `⏹` останавливает только
+  текущую сессию;
+* `task`-инструмент: субагент — дочерняя сессия (`parentID`) с ограниченным
+  набором инструментов (`OpenCodeTools.subagentTools`: `explore` — только
+  чтение, `general` — всё кроме `task`), выполняется синхронно на потоке
+  родителя и возвращает последний ассистентский текст; вложенность запрещена
+  (субагентам не выдаётся `task`); в системный промпт добавлен блок «Subagent»;
+* параллельный `bash` больше не затирает общий scratch-файл: имена
+  `cmd-<uuid>.py|js` уникальны и файл удаляется после запуска.
+
 ---
 
 ## 5. Как проверять
 
 Всё собирается в CI, локальный Android SDK не нужен:
 
 ```bash
 gh run watch
 gh run download --name pocketrun-apk
 ```
 
 Только лицензионная логика (JVM, без Android):
 
 ```bash
 tools/keygen/gradlew -p tools/keygen test
 android/gradlew -p android :app:testDebugUnitTest
 ```
 
 Выпуск ключа:
 
 ```bash
 tools/keygen/gradlew -p tools/keygen run --args="issue --name 'Jane Doe' --seat laptop --plan pro --days 30"
 ```
 
 ## 6. Известные ограничения
 
 * **Нет отзыва лицензий.** Только срок действия и смена публичного ключа в сборке.
 * **Нет отмены запуска Python.** Chaquopy не прерывает вызов.
 * **npm-пакеты с нативными аддонами или postinstall-скриптами** через npx не
   заработают: на устройстве нет компилятора C/C++, чистый JS работает.
 * **applets BusyBox не ограничены песочницей** — это настоящие нативные
   процессы с UID приложения: они могут читать/писать всё, что доступно
   приложению, а не только workspace (встроенные команды остаются в jail).
 * **APK большой** — CPython 3.13 (~30–40 МБ на ABI) плюс `libnode.so`
   (~50 МБ на ABI в сжатом виде); сборка ограничена `arm64-v8a` и `x86_64`.
 * **Rhino-фолбэк ограничен** — если нативный лаунчер недоступен, `node`
   деградирует до ES6-слоя без class/async/import.

40:     fun create(project: String?, title: String? = null, parentID: String? = null, model: String? = null): Session {

42:         val info = SessionInfo(
